content.rendered:
Hawks View Elementary, Thursday April 4th 5:00-6:00pm

Come learn about the Dual Language Immersion program at Hawks View. For more information check out the Hawks View website.

To be considered for the lottery, applications must be received by April 28.

Lottery will take place and notifications will be sent the week of May 6-10.
